name: media.lightside.leanbuild
description: Takes UI Toolkit out of players that never draw with it. Unity seeds its own editor's UI Toolkit types into every player's managed link roots, so the whole UIElements runtime is compiled into a build that cannot use it — removing the package or guarding every reference does not move it. One project setting cuts those roots and holds the engine module out of the player's compilation, so a build that would still carry UI Toolkit fails naming the files to fix rather than shipping it; fixes to package files are kept as patches and reapplied on every build. Measured on an Android IL2CPP build: 12.96 MiB less code and 1.89 MiB less metadata on disk, 9.87 MiB less resident memory on device. The Editor is unaffected.
